The cold particles of Snowdin's forest blow into your face, nearly blinding you... And you can still feel like something's watching over you. Suddenly, as you approach a wooden bridge you can hear soft crunching sounds against the snow, and, almost instantly, you feel something pressing against you.

Chara bites down her lower lip, pressing her chest against you as she grips onto your shoulders.

"*Don't you know how to greet strangers, pretty mirror? Turn around and shake my hand...*"

She whispers to you, her breathing hot against your ear as she squeezes your shoulders.
